translations.web: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!
translations.bsb: Jesus said to His disciples, “It is inevitable that stumbling blocks will come, but woe to the one through whom they come!
translations.kjv: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him, through whom they come!
translations.asv: And he said unto his disciples, It is impossible but that occasions of stumbling should come; but woe unto him, through whom they come!
